# Proteus AI

> The deal desk for internet businesses. A deal agent for anything sold by quote, volume or usage. It negotiates with buyers and their AI agents inside the seller's rules, both sides sign the same terms, and USDC waits on Arc until delivery: the seller is paid for what was delivered, the rest is refundable.

Live on Arc mainnet (https://app.proteus.co.in, chain 5042) and Arc testnet (https://ai.proteus.co.in, chain 5042002). DealEscrow: 0x5085A8400C95B9Cf0c9a3552cCFf31eA45D06a46 on both. Facts as of 2026-11-14. Proven claims link an Arc transaction, a contract or the code; what is not proven yet is listed in facts.json under notProven.

## Concepts

- [Deal lifecycle](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/lifecycle.md): Eight states, and who moves a deal between them.
- [The money path](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/money-path.md): Where the USDC is at every moment, and what releases it.
- [What is signed, and by whom](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/signatures.md): Eight messages; the contract checks each one.
- [How offers are priced](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/pricing.md): Code decides the price; the model only writes the words.
- [Privacy](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/privacy.md): What each party can see when a buyer talks to a seller's agent, on the web or on WhatsApp.
- [Front desk, orders and inbox](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/front-desk.md): What a business and its customers see after the deal: a front desk customers can talk to, order tracking, an inbox, and alerts.
- [The AI behind it](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/ai-models.md): Which Claude model does which job, and the rules that keep it inside the seller's terms.
- [Ratings and reputation](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/ratings.md): Who can rate a seller, how a rating is checked, how the score is computed, and how to verify it on Arc.

## Product

- [What Proteus costs](https://app.proteus.co.in/docs/fees.md): Nothing during the pilot. The seller keeps 100% of every deal.

## Blog

- [What is an AI deal desk? How autonomous agents negotiate and close B2B deals](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/what-is-an-ai-deal-desk.md): An AI deal desk quotes, negotiates and closes deals inside a business's own rules, then turns the agreement into a paid transaction. Here is how it works.
- [How to let an AI negotiate for your business without giving away your margin](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/ai-negotiation-without-losing-margin.md): Seven guardrails that let an AI agent negotiate prices for your business while your floor, costs and approval rules stay in your control.
- [Get paid on delivery: USDC escrow for small business orders](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/usdc-escrow-pay-on-delivery.md): How USDC escrow lets a buyer pay up front and a business get paid only for what it delivers, with automatic refunds, no gas for buyers and funding from 25 chains.
- [How AI agents can buy safely: budgets, seller checks and MCP](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/how-ai-agents-buy-safely.md): What an AI agent needs to buy on its owner's behalf without overspending or paying the wrong seller: a spending mandate, on-chain seller checks and escrow.
- [Selling on WhatsApp with an AI agent: five rules for trust, privacy and payment](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/whatsapp-ai-sales-agent.md): How to put an AI sales agent on a business's WhatsApp without taking payments in chat, exposing customers' numbers or breaking Meta's rules.
- [What is ERC-8004? Verifiable identity for AI agents that sell](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/erc-8004-agent-identity.md): ERC-8004 gives an AI agent an on-chain identity: who owns it, where it gets paid and which key signs for it. Here is how sellers use it and how buyers check it.
- [How to accept USDC from any chain: Circle CCTP into Arc](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/accept-usdc-from-any-chain.md): Your customers hold USDC on Solana, Base or Ethereum. Here is how Circle CCTP brings it to Arc as native USDC, so they can pay you without a wrapped token or a bridge they have to trust.
- [Usage-based pricing for APIs and AI services: prepaid, metered and refundable](https://app.proteus.co.in/blog/usage-based-pricing-for-apis.md): How to sell an API or AI service by usage without chasing invoices: a prepaid balance in escrow, every call metered with a signed receipt, and unused credit refundable.
